PDF Hardware-Accelerated Parallel Non-Photorealistic Volume Rendering
Abstract Non-photorealistic rendering can be used to illustrate subtle spa-tial relationships that might not be visible with more realistic ren-dering techniques. We present a parallel hardware-accelerated rendering technique, making extensive use of multi-texturing and paletted textures, for the interactive non-photorealistic visualiza-tion of scalar volume data.
